FAQ_1.Q: What does "Priority Attention" mean in Sery's panel?
FAQ_1.A: It is a smart alert that Sery generates when a student falls below 50% of average performance, suggesting immediate actions to prevent academic lag.

FAQ_2.Q: How does Sery evaluate Topic Mastery?
FAQ_2.A: Sery calculates the average grades of each evaluated topic and classifies it using colors to help you quickly identify knowledge gaps in the classroom.

FAQ_3.Q: Can I generate personalized quizzes for a student?
FAQ_3.A: Yes. Sery allows you to generate a "Review Quiz" focused exclusively on the subtopics where the student obtained the lowest scores.

FAQ_4.Q: What is the difference between the Teacher and Coordinator view?
FAQ_4.A: The Teacher manages the progress of their own classrooms and repository. The Coordinator has additional access to "Area Metrics", which allows them to compare the performance of all classrooms and identify macro-level trends.

FAQ_5.Q: How is the Average Grades Trend calculated?
FAQ_5.A: All assessments and assignments completed by the students of a classroom during the corresponding academic week are averaged.
